title: Foundations of Broadcasting  Film
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used in media transmission. 3."
Describe how electromagnetic waves are used in media transmission. 3.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the space where presenters, actors, or guests perform and where audio or visual content is recorded."
The broadcast studio is the space where presenters, actors, or guests perform and where audio or visual content is recorded.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to set the mood, tone, and emotional atmosphere of a programme."
Music is used to set the mood, tone, and emotional atmosphere of a programme.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a collective process requiring coordination among technical, creative, and administrative units (Küng, 2017; Zettl, 2018)."
Scholars note that media production is a collective process requiring coordination among technical, creative, and administrative units (Küng, 2017; Zettl, 2018).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a medium of storytelling that uses moving images, sound, and narrative structures to create artistic and cultural expressions."
Film is a medium of storytelling that uses moving images, sound, and narrative structures to create artistic and cultural expressions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the policies, laws, and institutional frameworks that guide broadcasting activities within a country."
Broadcast regulation refers to the policies, laws, and institutional frameworks that guide broadcasting activities within a country.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an audiovisual medium that combines sound and moving images to communicate messages."
Television is an audiovisual medium that combines sound and moving images to communicate messages.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the electromagnetic waves that carry information from the broadcasting station to receivers such as radios, televisions, and mobile devices."
Broadcast signals are the electromagnetic waves that carry information from the broadcasting station to receivers such as radios, televisions, and mobile devices.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the integration of media technologies, industries, and content."
Media convergence refers to the integration of media technologies, industries, and content.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the channel through which messages are transmitted from a sender to a receiver."
A communication medium refers to the channel through which messages are transmitted from a sender to a receiver.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a primary function of broadcasting and film."
Information dissemination is a primary function of broadcasting and film.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the complete range of electromagnetic radiation arranged according to frequency or wavelength."
The electromagnetic spectrum is the complete range of electromagnetic radiation arranged according to frequency or wavelength.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a facility equipped with the necessary technology and personnel to produce and transmit radio or television programs to the public."
Broadcast Stations A broadcast station is a facility equipped with the necessary technology and personnel to produce and transmit radio or television programs to the public.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the number of wave cycles that occur in one second and is measured in Hertz (Hz)."
Frequency refers to the number of wave cycles that occur in one second and is measured in Hertz (Hz).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the location where programs are recorded or produced, while the control room is the technical hub where production activities are monitored and coordinated."
The studio is the location where programs are recorded or produced, while the control room is the technical hub where production activities are monitored and coordinated.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to any content produced for radio or television transmission, including news, talk shows, documentaries, and dramas."
A broadcast programme refers to any content produced for radio or television transmission, including news, talk shows, documentaries, and dramas.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the distribution of audio and visual content to a dispersed audience through electronic mass communication mediums such as radio and television."
Broadcasting refers to the distribution of audio and visual content to a dispersed audience through electronic mass communication mediums such as radio and television.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the systematic sequence of activities through which media messages are conceived, produced, transmitted, received, and interpreted by a mass audience."
The process of broadcasting refers to the systematic sequence of activities through which media messages are conceived, produced, transmitted, received, and interpreted by a mass audience.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the process through which individuals and groups share Foundations of Broadcasting & Film (2026) Deni s O."
Social communication refers to the process through which individuals and groups share Foundations of Broadcasting & Film (2026) Deni s O.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to mobilise citizens during elections, health campaigns, and national development initiatives."
Social Mobilisation Broadcasting is used to mobilise citizens during elections, health campaigns, and national development initiatives.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the transmission of audio signals through electromagnetic waves to a dispersed audience."
Radio broadcasting is the transmission of audio signals through electromagnetic waves to a dispersed audience.

Nigerian Film Corporation

broadcast signal

Modulation

carrier wave

______ refers to the group of professionals who work together to produce and distribute media content.
crew

control room
